ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Career Planning for History Majors Topic: As a History major, you have learned a lot about research, analysis, and problem solving, but you learn and describe these skills within an academic discipline that categorizes knowledge and competencies differently than the workplace does. In this course you will learn to translate your academic abilities into career-specific terms. You will inventory your interests and skills, identify careers that reflect your ambitions, and practice marketing your qualifications to employers. Topics to be covered include writing a resume, crafting application letters, and interviewing; we will research companies, attend a job fair, and practice networking. You will emerge with a five-year plan for making the transition from college to post-graduation success.
